# Wycheproof test vectors

These files are copied unchanged from [C2SP/wycheproof](https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof), commit `65ca494727a52944c204441c860b039e6786b99b`, directory `testvectors_v1`. They are licensed under the Apache License 2.0, like goraz.

They are pinned so that tests don't depend on the network. To update them, copy the same files from a newer commit and change the commit above.
